description: This file contains the implementation of functorch's Python bindings for PyTorch, including functions for tensor manipulation, batching, functionalization, and dynamic layer management, as well as registration of these functions and related classes/enums for Python exposure.

classes.name: DynamicLayer
classes.description: Represents a dynamic layer in the functorch stack, used for managing transformations like vmap, grad, jvp, and functionalize.

classes.name: CInterpreter
classes.description: A class representing an interpreter with methods for key, level, serialize, and deserialize.

classes.name: CGradInterpreterPtr
classes.description: A smart pointer to an Interpreter for gradient transformations, with methods for key, level, lift, and prevGradMode.

classes.name: CJvpInterpreterPtr
classes.description: A smart pointer to an Interpreter for JVP transformations, with methods for key, level, lift, and prevFwdGradMode.

classes.name: CVmapInterpreterPtr
classes.description: A smart pointer to an Interpreter for vmap transformations, with methods for key, level, batchSize, and randomness.

classes.name: CFunctionalizeInterpreterPtr
classes.description: A smart pointer to an Interpreter for functionalization, with methods for key, level, and functionalizeAddBackViews.

methods.name: _add_batch_dim
methods.description: Adds a batch dimension to a tensor at a specified level.

methods.name: _remove_batch_dim
methods.description: Removes a batch dimension at a specified level, possibly returning a regular tensor.

methods.name: _unwrap_batched
methods.description: Unwraps a batched tensor if it matches the specified level.

methods.name: _wrap_functional_tensor
methods.description: Wraps a tensor as a functional tensor and sets its level.

methods.name: _assert_wrapped_functional
methods.description: Asserts that one tensor is a functional tensor and another is not, and they are correctly linked.

methods.name: _propagate_functional_input_mutation
methods.description: Propagates mutations from a wrapped functional tensor to its unwrapped version.

methods.name: _unwrap_functional_tensor
methods.description: Unwraps a functional tensor, optionally adding back views.

methods.name: _vmap_increment_nesting
methods.description: Increments the nesting level for vmap.

methods.name: _vmap_decrement_nesting
methods.description: Decrements the nesting level for vmap.

methods.name: _func_increment_nesting
methods.description: Starts a functionalization nesting level.

methods.name: _func_decrement_nesting
methods.description: Ends a functionalization nesting level.

methods.name: _grad_increment_nesting
methods.description: Starts a gradient nesting level.

methods.name: _grad_decrement_nesting
methods.description: Ends a gradient nesting level.

methods.name: _jvp_increment_nesting
methods.description: Starts a JVP nesting level.

methods.name: _jvp_decrement_nesting
methods.description: Ends a JVP nesting level.

methods.name: _wrap_for_grad
methods.description: Wraps a tensor for gradient tracking at a specified level.

methods.name: _unwrap_for_grad
methods.description: Unwraps a tensor from gradient tracking at a specified level.

methods.name: dlevel
methods.description: Returns the level of a tensor if wrapped, or -1 if not.

methods.name: dump_tensor
methods.description: Dumps tensor information for debugging.

methods.name: is_batchedtensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a batched tensor.

methods.name: is_legacy_batchedtensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a legacy batched tensor.

methods.name: is_gradtrackingtensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a gradient tracking tensor.

methods.name: is_functionaltensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a functional tensor.

methods.name: get_unwrapped
methods.description: Retrieves the unwrapped tensor from wrappers.

methods.name: maybe_get_level
methods.description: Gets the level of a tensor if wrapped.

methods.name: _maybe_unsafe_set_level
methods.description: Unsafely sets the level of a batched tensor.

methods.name: maybe_get_bdim
methods.description: Gets the batch dimension index of a tensor if batched.

methods.name: maybe_current_level
methods.description: Gets the current dynamic layer level if available.

methods.name: current_level
methods.description: Returns the current dynamic layer level.

methods.name: tls_set_vmap_excluded
methods.description: Sets whether vmap is excluded in thread-local storage.

methods.name: _set_dynamic_layer_keys_included
methods.description: Includes or excludes dynamic layer keys.

methods.name: dump_dls
methods.description: Dumps the current dynamic layer stack.

methods.name: dump_local_tls
methods.description: Dumps local thread-local storage info.

methods.name: is_functorch_wrapped_tensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is wrapped by functorch.

methods.name: get_interpreter_stack
methods.description: Retrieves the current interpreter stack.

methods.name: peek_interpreter_stack
methods.description: Peeks at the top interpreter in the stack.

methods.name: get_dynamic_layer_stack_depth
methods.description: Returns the depth of the dynamic layer stack.

methods.name: pop_dynamic_layer_stack_and_undo_to_depth
methods.description: Pops the stack to a specific depth, undoing layers.

methods.name: pop_dynamic_layer_stack
methods.description: Pops the top dynamic layer.

methods.name: push_dynamic_layer_stack
methods.description: Pushes a new dynamic layer onto the stack.
